title: Created a factory game
author: oguzkaanarda
selftext:
I've been developing this factory game in Godot for a while now. I think we don't even need to talk about how good AI has gotten on the coding side anymore.

I can handle 3D modeling myself, but I have no experience with audio design. I tried using AI for both 3D assets and sound effects, but the results didn't really satisfy me, they still feel a bit lacking in quality.

Since the audio ends up being synthesized via code, it sounds way too robotic and flat. The 3D generation side is slightly better, though it still struggles a lot with complex parts.

Has anyone managed to get solid results with AI for 3D or audio? Curious to hear your thoughts and workflows.

  
if anyone intrested here is the link: [https://ogzkaanarda.itch.io/unfactory](https://ogzkaanarda.itch.io/unfactory)
